scenarios.label: clean_live_execute
scenarios.description: Strong calibration, healthy liquidity, clean pricing → EXECUTE_YES in live

scenarios.label: stale_pricing_reject
scenarios.description: Pricing snapshot is 200s old (>120s threshold) → STALE_PRICING reject in live

scenarios.label: weak_calibration_reject
scenarios.description: CalibrationQuality.WEAK → WEAK_CALIBRATION reject in live-like mode

scenarios.label: partial_fill_rejected_or_small_fill
scenarios.description: Liquidity=50 USDC, intended_size=20 USDC → partial fill scenario in live mode

scenarios.label: paper_loose_pass_live_reject
scenarios.description: Weak calibration: live and paper_strict reject. paper_loose may execute depending on threshold. This is the observation zone — paper_loose results are NOT pilot evidence.
scenarios.interpretation: If paper_loose=EXECUTE and live=REJECT: this candidate is in the OBSERVATION ZONE. paper_loose execution here provides ZERO evidence of live readiness.

scenarios.label: insufficient_evidence_no_go
scenarios.description: Only 5 live-like records over <1 day → evidence gate fails → NO_GO
scenarios.verdict_reason: Insufficient shadow evidence: Need 50 live-like evaluated decisions for meaningful statistics; have 5.; Need 10 live-like execute decisions to observe EV distribution; have 1.; Need 20 live-like reject decisions to observe rejection composition; have 4.; Need 3.0 calendar days of observation; have 0.17. A short sample cannot distinguish stable from lucky.

scenarios.label: high_execution_rate_warn_or_blocker
scenarios.description: Very permissive policy (paper_loose, high confidence) → very high execution rate. If >85% → BLOCKER. If 60-85% → WARN. Gates not functioning when everything passes.
scenarios.verdict_reason: Insufficient shadow evidence: Need 5 live-like execute decisions to observe EV distribution; have 1.

scenarios.label: candidate_for_pilot_review
scenarios.description: Sufficient corpus, behavioral checks pass → readiness assessment available. Verdict depends on actual metric values. See readiness_report_sample.json for full detail.
